question_or_heading: What are the Motorcycle Hire Purchase-i and Auto Hire Purchase-i financing facilities?
answer_or_body: Motorcycle Hire Purchase-i and Auto Hire Purchase-i are Shariah-compliant vehicle financing facilities offered by AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad based on Islamic financing principles. Under these facilities, the Company purchases the specified vehicle from an authorised dealer and hires it to the customer with an undertaking to transfer vehicle ownership upon full settlement of all contractual instalments and dues.

question_or_heading: What is the maximum financing margin available for standard vehicles?
answer_or_body: For standard internal combustion engine passenger cars financed under Auto Hire Purchase-i, the maximum financing margin is up to 90% of the vehicle invoice purchase price or market value. For standard internal combustion engine motorcycles financed under Motorcycle Hire Purchase-i, the maximum financing margin is also up to 90%.

question_or_heading: What is the maximum financing margin for electric motorcycles (e-motorcycles)?
answer_or_body: Financing for newly registered electric motorcycles (e-motorcycles) under the Motorcycle Hire Purchase-i facility is capped at a maximum financing margin of 85% of the vehicle purchase price, requiring a minimum customer down payment of 15%.

question_or_heading: What financing tenures are offered for hire purchase facilities?
answer_or_body: Financing tenures depend on the facility category. Motorcycle Hire Purchase-i offers flexible tenures ranging from 12 months up to a maximum of 60 months. Auto Hire Purchase-i offers financing tenures ranging from 12 months up to a maximum of 108 months, subject to vehicle age, model, and credit assessment.

question_or_heading: What are the credit assessment and CTOS score requirements?
answer_or_body: Applicants are evaluated against the Company credit underwriting standards. A CTOS score of 700 and above qualifies for the prime pricing tier, while scores between 650 and 699 are eligible under standard pricing terms. Applications with a CTOS score below 650 cannot proceed via the automated straight-through approval path and require manual review by a Senior Underwriter. Any record of bankruptcy, active legal action, or adverse AKPK flagging results in an absolute decline.

question_or_heading: How is the Debt Service Ratio (DSR) evaluated for vehicle financing?
answer_or_body: The projected Debt Service Ratio (DSR) is evaluated after taking into account the proposed monthly hire purchase instalment and is binding. For applicants with a gross monthly income of less than RM 3,000, the maximum allowable DSR ceiling is 60%. For applicants with a gross monthly income of RM 3,000 and above, the DSR ceiling is capped at 70%.

question_or_heading: What is the minimum Net Disposable Income (NDI) requirement?
answer_or_body: Effective 1 January 2026 under Credit Policy v2, applicants must demonstrate a minimum Net Disposable Income (NDI) floor of RM 1,500 calculated after the facility is drawn in full and all statutory deductions and debt obligations are met. For applicants supporting three (3) or more dependants, a higher NDI floor of RM 2,000 is strictly mandatory.

question_or_heading: Can I apply if I have arrears on existing facilities or participate in an AKPK programme?
answer_or_body: Applicants with any existing credit facility currently two (2) or more months in arrears are not eligible and will be declined. Furthermore, applicants currently enrolled in an active AKPK Debt Management Programme (DMP) are not eligible for new financing facilities.

question_or_heading: Is motor takaful or comprehensive vehicle insurance compulsory?
answer_or_body: Yes. Throughout the entire financing tenure, the customer must maintain comprehensive motor takaful or insurance coverage on the financed vehicle for an agreed sum insured not less than the outstanding financing balance or prevailing market value. The policy must endorse AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad as the sole loss payee and legal owner.

question_or_heading: Who holds the vehicle ownership title during the financing tenure?
answer_or_body: Legal ownership of the vehicle remains registered with AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad, and an ownership claim endorsement (Hak Milik) is lodged with Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan (JPJ). The customer acts as the registered hirer and custodian with full possession and operational responsibility.

question_or_heading: How is ownership transferred to me after final payment?
answer_or_body: Upon full settlement of all outstanding principal, accrued profit charges, and administrative fees, the Company will issue a formal Letter of Release (Pelepasan Hak Milik) and update the JPJ e-Hakmilik system to cancel the ownership claim, transferring unencumbered legal title directly to the hirer.

question_or_heading: Can I perform early settlement of my hire purchase facility?
answer_or_body: Yes. Customers may settle their financing balance prior to the maturity date. In accordance with Malaysian statutory hire purchase regulations and Islamic banking standards, an early settlement rebate (Ibra) on unearned profit charges will be credited against the total outstanding redemption balance.

question_or_heading: What happens if I encounter difficulties paying my monthly instalments?
answer_or_body: If you face financial hardship, you must notify the Company immediately before two consecutive monthly instalments fall into arrears. Failure to pay monthly dues on time leads to late payment charges, adverse credit reporting to CTOS and CCRIS, and potential repossession procedures pursuant to statutory hire purchase law.

question_or_heading: How do I lodge a service complaint or dispute regarding my account?
answer_or_body: Complaints may be submitted through our customer service hotline, official branches, or dedicated email channel. The Company will formally acknowledge all complaints within two (2) business days and aims to investigate and resolve issues within fourteen (14) calendar days.

question_or_heading: What escalation channel is available if a complaint remains unresolved?
answer_or_body: If a complaint cannot be resolved satisfactorily through the internal dispute resolution procedure of AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad within the stipulated timeline, customers may escalate their dispute to the Ombudsman for Financial Services (OFS) or Bank Negara Malaysia LINK for independent redress.
